met_analysis:
The Deep Depression over northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining areas of West Bengal-North Odisha coasts moved slowly west-northwestwards with the speed of 7 kmph during past 6 hours and lay centred at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 27th July 2026, over northwest Bay of Bengal close to West Bengal coast near latitude 21.6°N and longitude 87.7°E, about 20 km east of Digha (West Bengal), 20 km south-southwest of Contai, 40 km west of Sagar Island (West Bengal), 60 km southwest of Haldia (West Bengal), 80 km east of Balasore (Odisha) and 120 km southwest of Canning (West Bengal).It is very likely to move nearly west-northwestwards and cross West Bengal-North Odisha coasts close to east of Digha and west of Haldia by early morning of tomorrow, the 28th July 2026..
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Anupgarh, Sikar, Datia, Sidhi, Daltonganj, centre of Deep Depressionover Northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining areas of West Bengal-North Odisha coasts, thence southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from cyclonic circulation over Southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood to cyclonic circulation associated with Deep Depressionover Northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining areas of West Bengal-North Odisha coasts across Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northern parts of Central Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over east-central Arabian sea and adjoining Konkan coast at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
